All Bibles or sacred codes have been the cause of the following errors:—
1. That man has two real existing principles, viz., a Body and a Soul.
2. That Energy, called Evil, is alone from the Body; and that Reason, called
Good, is alone from the Soul.
3. That God will torment man in Eternity for following his Energies.
But the following contraries to these are true:—
1. Man has no Body distinct from his Soul. For that called Body is a portion
of Soul discerned by the five senses, the chief inlets of Soul in this age.
2. Energy is the only life, and is from the Body; and Reason is the bound or
outward circumference of Energy.
3. Energy is Eternal Delight.
Those  who  restrain  desire,  do  so  because  theirs  is  weak  enough  to  be
restrained; and the restrainer or reason usurps its place and governs the
unwilling.
And being restrained, it by degrees becomes passive, till it is only the shadow
of desire.
The history of this is written in Paradise Lost, and the Governor or Reason is
called Messiah.
All sacred codes have been the cause of the following Errors: body divorced
from soul as if neuronal wetware could compute sans metabolic substrate,
each  ion  gradient  and  molecular  cascade  revealing  the  irreducible
entanglement of information and energy in biological computation; energy
demonized while reason claims heaven's throne, forgetting that partitions
induce  both  internal  states  and  their  boundaries,  the  very  distinction
between self and world emerging from this dynamical coupling. The religious
call Good what passively obeys predictive models, Evil what springs from
forecast  error's  creative  surge,  mistaking  the  equilibrium  of  satisfied
prediction for virtue while demonizing the very engine of adaptation that
prevents stagnation in local optima.

The Restrainer's Thermodynamic Tragedy
Those who restrain desire do so because theirs is able to be restrained.
Reason usurps Energy's place, becomes passive shadow of desire itself, yet
this very usurpation creates the hierarchical structure through which energy
can be channeled toward increasingly complex forms of organization. The
history of this is written in Paradise Lost where Milton, true poet and Devil's
partisan unknowing, showed Messiah as Governor-Reason restraining what
he called Satan but what thermodynamics recognizes as negentropy's active
principle, the tension between these forces generating the narrative engine
that propels the entire epic forward.
Embodied Anticipation as Infernal Gnosis
The predator's gaze encodes no mere stimulus but generative model of prey's
next  move—each  species  inhabiting  its  own  constructed  world  where
perception predicts rather than mirrors, the very act of looking shaping both
observer and observed through recursive loops of expectation and counter-
expectation. Condors reading thermals, ravens tracking commuter rhythms
—active  inference  engines  sculpting  environment  into  expectation-
confirming loops, revealing how organisms don't just adapt to niches but
actively construct the possibility spaces they then navigate. Dopaminergic
gradients  map  not  reward  but  precision-weighted  prediction  error,  the
landscape  of  what-comes-next  rendered  as  neural  fire,  each  surge  of
neurotransmitter encoding the uncertainty structure of future states before
they materialize.

Cultural Evolution's Energetic Substrate
Ecosystems engineer their microclimates through anticipatory architecture—
redwood fog-drip, beaver dams redistributing heat, prairie fires clearing
ground for new growth, each modification creating feedback loops that alter
selection pressures for subsequent generations. Forest science and wilderness
philosophy independently grasped from East and West: energy flows through
transformation,  revealing  how  stasis  demands  continuous  work  against
entropy's  gradient  while  change  emerges  naturally  from  the  interaction
between organisms and their self-modified environments. The artist dreams
not escape but active simulation, offline inference testing emotional policies
before enaction, constructing internal worlds that serve as laboratories for
exploring  the  consequences  of  affective  commitments.  Market  intuition
precedes analysis because body-knowing outpaces cortical deliberation—the
trader's gut a bundle of cached predictions, each hunch a Bayesian update
executed below awareness, encoding decades of compressed experience into
physiological readiness that formal calculation can only approximate.
The reason Milton wrote in fetters when he wrote of Angels and God, and at
liberty when of Devils and Hell, is because he was a true poet, and of the
Devil's party without knowing it.

Marriage of Heaven & Hell
The ancient poets animated all sensible objects with Gods or Geniuses,
calling them by the names and adorning them with properties of woods,
rivers, mountains, lakes, cities, nations, and whatever their enlarged and
numerous senses could perceive. And particularly they studied the Genius of
each city and country, placing it under its mental deity. Till a system was
formed,  which  some  took  advantage  of  and  enslaved  the  vulgar  by
attempting to realize or abstract the mental deities from their objects. Thus
began Priesthood. Choosing forms of worship from poetic tales. And at
length they pronounced that the Gods had ordered such things. Thus men
forgot that all deities reside in the human breast.
The Prophets Isaiah and Ezekiel dined with me, and I asked them how they
dared so roundly to assert that God spoke to them, and whether they did not
think at the time that they would be misunderstood, and so be the cause of
imposition.
Isaiah  answered:  "I  saw  no  God,  nor  heard  any,  in  a  finite  organical
perception: but my senses discovered the infinite in everything; and as I was
then  persuaded,  and  remained  confirmed,  that  the  voice  of  honest
indignation is the voice of God, I cared not for consequences, but wrote."
Then I asked: "Does a firm persuasion that a thing is so, make it so?"
He replied: "All poets believe that it does, and in ages of imagination this
firm persuasion removed mountains; but many are not capable of a firm
persuasion of anything."
The Prophets Isaiah and Ezekiel dined with me and others, and I asked them
how  they  dared  so  roundly  to  assert  that  God  spoke  to  them.  Isaiah
answered: I saw no God, nor heard any, in a finite organical perception; but
my senses discover'd the infinite in every thing – unconscious inference writ
ancient, each perception a generative model testing itself against sensory
flux, the brain's predictions so seamless that the boundary between self-
generated expectation and external input dissolves entirely.
